lines.zh: 长腿一迈，我跑得比谁都快。
lines.en: Long legs, and no one outruns me.
I waddle like a goose as I go.
Neck out, eyes scanning everywhere.

lines.zh: 草地上的虫子，我顺手啄。
lines.en: A bug in the grass — I peck it up.

lines.zh: 成群走才安心，落单心虚。
lines.en: Safer in a flock; alone I'm nervous.
My toes grip; I turn sharply.
When I run, dust flies up.
Long legs help me see far.
I follow the one ahead of me.
My feathers rasp against the grass.

lines.zh: 别看我像鸟，我可没翅膀。
lines.en: Birdlike, but I have no wings.
A hop per step; light on my feet.
One peck, two steps.
I step around rocks to avoid tripping.
Neck stretched, I listen around.

lines.zh: 忽然一声鹅叫，把自己吓到。
lines.en: A sudden honk — I startled myself.
I tilt my head at my shadow.

lines.zh: 整群都安静了，怪不习惯。
lines.en: The whole flock is quiet; that's odd.
I fluff my feathers; the wind is cool.
Even standing, I keep looking about.
A rumble in my throat wants out.

lines.zh: 我把脖子弯回来，蹭蹭胸口。
lines.en: I bend my neck back and nuzzle my chest.
Holding still — I'm just tense.
I scratch the ground twice.
That call in the distance — my flock?

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，让日头烤着背。
lines.en: I half-close my eyes and let the sun bake my back.

lines.zh: 我的影子细长，像根杆子。
lines.en: My shadow is long and thin as a pole.
Nothing to eat, so I stare — normal.

lines.zh: 你也在看我？我先叫一声。
lines.en: Watching me? I'll honk first.

lines.zh: 你的手指一动，我的腿就绷紧。
lines.en: Your fingers twitch, and my legs go taut.

lines.zh: 你站那儿不动，我拿不准。
lines.en: You stand so still, I cannot read you.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估量你的大小。
lines.en: Head tilted, I size you up.
Do you smell of food?

lines.zh: 两眼看你，脖子却往后缩。
lines.en: Eyes on you, neck pulling back.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，只擅长跑。
lines.en: I'm bad at fighting, good at running.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我这样子很正常。
lines.en: What's funny? I look perfectly normal.
Too close — I'm going to honk.
I'm noting every move you make.
Any wrong move and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我偏着头看你，一只眼一只眼。
lines.en: I tip my head to size you up, one eye at a time.
Ow! I jumped away.

lines.zh: 疼得我缩起脖子，叫声都变调。
lines.en: The pain makes me duck my neck, my honk cracking.
These thin legs can't take much.
Stop it — I'll run, okay?
The shock sets me honking.
A limp slows me down.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肋上，我记仇。
lines.en: That one caught my ribs, and I will not forget it.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我往群里缩。
lines.en: Taking that hit, I shrink back into the flock.
Pain leaves me gasping.
The skin beneath my feathers is thin.
Those berries look decent.
I'm not picky; bugs will do.
Open your palm and I'll dare approach.

lines.zh: 香气飘过来，腿自己动了。
lines.en: The smell drifts over and my legs move.
Don't grab me — just offer food.
I'll peck once and dash.
The flock is grabbing; I want some.
Not enough here to share with the flock.
I circle once before coming in.
Head down to eat, tail still up.

lines.zh: 撞到我了，翅膀似的胳膊一摆。
lines.en: You bumped me; my wing-arms flail.
Whoa, I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我第一反应是跑。
lines.en: You charge, and my first thought is run.
I'm light; one bump and I bounce off.
Don't crowd me; we barely know each other.
My legs wobble, then steady.
Path's too narrow for both of us.
I step back and let you pass.
I tip sideways and straighten up.

lines.zh: 肩头被撞歪，我踉跄两步。
lines.en: My shoulder is knocked askew and I stumble two steps.
That one there has tidy tail feathers.

lines.zh: 我叼根草过去，算是礼物。
lines.en: I bring a blade of grass as a gift.
We circle each other, nodding.

lines.zh: 叫声对上，就是有意思了。
lines.en: Our calls match — that means something.
Eating side by side, no snatching.
I pace back and forth beside her.

lines.zh: 趁天还暖，我多绕她两圈。
lines.en: While it is still warm, I circle her two more times.
She runs, and I give chase.
Two pairs of long legs, side by side.

lines.zh: 她点了下头，我就跟在后头。
lines.en: She dips her head, so I trail after her.

lines.zh: 果子滚到脚边，我一嘴叼走。
lines.en: A fruit rolls to my feet and I snatch it up.
I pinch it with my beak, secure.
Doesn't matter what it is; I grab it.
The flock will try to steal this.

lines.zh: 喙尖戳了戳，是软的，能吃。
lines.en: My beak pokes it: soft, so it is food.
It drops, and I peck it up.

lines.zh: 我藏不住东西，藏了也忘。
lines.en: I can't hide things; I'd forget where.
I carry it a while before swallowing.
Whose? No questions — I eat.

lines.zh: 喙很灵，小东西也夹得住。
lines.en: My beak is nimble, even for small things.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我竖起脖子。
lines.en: Something's near; my neck goes stiff.
That's not a flock scent.
I honk first, calling the flock to look.
My eyes lock on that direction.

lines.zh: 我不主动，但会跑给你看。
lines.en: I won't start it, but watch me run.
Legs are tense, ready to bolt.
Who are you? Stand still.
The whole flock has looked up.

lines.zh: 那团影子一动，我脖子就竖起来。
lines.en: The shadow stirs, and my neck snaps upright.
One more step and I honk.
That sound bodes ill.
I've got your position in my head.
The grass doesn't hide you.
The whole flock is watching; don't move.
Still following? I'm calling the flock.
I run in circles, can't shake you.
Neck stretched long — that's a warning.
Don't push me; fleeing is all I do.
The flock scattered — bad.

lines.zh: 我绕着蕨丛跑，脖子老往后扭。
lines.en: I circle the ferns, my neck craning back.
The closer you get, the louder I honk.
Legs ache, but I can't stop.
Nowhere to hide on this grass.
I'll try circling behind that tree.
You're slow; I still have a chance.
Running all day — I'm tired.
Don't surround me; I'll crash about.

lines.zh: 我们这样僵着，不是办法。
lines.en: This standoff gets us nowhere.
I'll make for higher ground.
A kick from me!
My beak isn't just for show.
Not the tail feathers!
I peck while backing off.
My kick throws up dirt.
One shove, then I run.

lines.zh: 我叫着扑上去，其实很怕。
lines.en: I lunge honking, though I'm scared.
My claws kick and I spring back.
Skinny doesn't mean weak.
One bite, then let go fast.
After the kick I'm panting.
The whole flock joins in.
That hit was mostly for courage.
Long legs, so my kick reaches.

lines.zh: 草叶分开，我伸长脖子站出来。
lines.en: The grass parts and I step out, neck stretched.

lines.zh: 落地先甩甩腿，再叫两声。
lines.en: I land, shake out my legs, and honk twice.
Plains? I like this.

lines.zh: 三两只一起，我们成队走来。
lines.en: Two or three of us arrive together.

lines.zh: 脖子先出来，脑袋转了半圈。
lines.en: Neck first, head swiveling.
I land lightly, almost silent.
Are there many bugs here?
I shake my feathers and settle.
That distant honk is calling me.
So quiet the moment I arrive.
I look about and pick a direction.
One stride and I'm far off.
Who's here? I'm a bit scared.
We come as a flock, and we're loud.

lines.zh: 尘土刚落，我已经跑了一圈。
lines.en: Dust barely settled and I've done a lap.

lines.zh: 我来找吃的，不是找架打。
lines.en: I came for food, not a fight.

lines.zh: 这只的叫声，跟我不一样。
lines.en: This one's call sounds different.
Steady; first check the terrain.

lines.zh: 火苗燎到羽毛，焦味刺鼻。
lines.en: Flame catches my feathers; the stink of singe.
I land on my legs and they go numb.

lines.zh: 水漫过脖子，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: Water over my neck; I kick desperately.
The blast throws me several paces.
An arrow pierces my wing.
Strange force bears down; my legs wobble.

lines.zh: 饿得腿发软，叫都没力气。
lines.en: Hunger weakens my legs; I can't even honk.
Lightning strikes and every feather stands.

lines.zh: 我把腿蹬空了，一直往下掉。
lines.en: My legs kick nothing; I keep falling.
